definitions.A: actual integrated material absorption; PML leakage is a numerical residual and is not double-counted as material A
definitions.R: upward/backward propagating modal power normalized by incident +z power at Z_IN_REF
definitions.T: downward/+z transmitted propagating modal power on air side at Z_POSTNP_REF

APCD_GAN_NATIVE_M1.accounting: actual material absorption included in A

APCD_SIO2_NATIVE_M1.accounting: lossless over sampled native band within tolerance

APCD_TIO2_NATIVE_M1.accounting: lossless over sampled native band within tolerance

Air.accounting: lossless over sampled native band within tolerance

numerical_gate: abs(1-(R+T+A)) < 0.01 at every wavelength after real calibration
